subject: Commit validation: LumenTech renewal — evidence queue & churn signals
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-09-05T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Commit validation: LumenTech renewal — evidence queue & churn signals

Team — quick status and ask on LumenTech (LDL-4521), renewal due 2027-10-15. Finance flagged an ARR variance that will block commit unless we supply billing evidence + stage justification by next Friday. Summary: current renewal ARR $420k (annualized). Usage dropped ~18% MoM in Aug (see attached).

Key asks: 
- Karthik: can you confirm primary contact for legal/procurement and whether we have signed SOW addendum? (Needed for stage = Commit)
- Naomi / FinOps: please review the attached MRR spreadsheet and add one-line ledger evidence (invoice numbers + payment dates) into the Drive folder linked below.
- Marissa: capture any CS risk signals (feature gaps, support tickets) so we can annotate churn-risk reason in HubSpot.

Notes: 
- I created a minimal evidence checklist (renewal-evidence-checklist.pdf) and dropped it in the Drive link. If we can get invoices + invoice dates + renewal PO, we should be able to hold commit. If not, we need to move to "At Risk" and schedule a senior exec call.

Attachments: LumenTech_MRR_breakdown.xlsx, renewal-evidence-checklist.pdf

Next steps: please update HubSpot (Deal LDL-4521) with exact evidence items by 2027-09-10 EOD. I'll run a commit-ownership pass on 2027-09-11 at 9am PT and prepare an escalation plan if items are missing.

Thanks —
Aditya
Aditya Rao | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commit validation: LumenTech renewal — evidence queue & churn signals

Aditya — quick notes: 
- I have the primary procurement contact (Amy Liu, amy.liu@lumentech.com). She confirmed they issued a PO for last renewal cycle but procurement has a new approver set for 2027. I'll loop Amy and copy procurement.
- No signed SOW addendum on file (I looked in Deal LDL-4521 attachments). Legal has a copy of the master agreement only.

I'll ping Amy now and ask for the PO number + last paid invoice PDF. HubSpot note: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/LDL-4521 (I'll add an interim note: evidence-requested).

Action: Amy / finance to provide invoice PDFs by 2027-09-09. If we don't get them, let's plan a short call and set stage to "At Risk" on 9/12.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Jessica Park <jessica@lumentech.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: LumenTech Finance <finance@lumentech.com>
Date: 2027-09-06T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commit validation: LumenTech renewal — evidence queue & churn signals

Hi Aditya / Karthik / Naomi —

Thanks for the heads up. We did see the usage dip in August (we moved some internal workloads to an on-prem pilot for cost reasons). Finance is pulling the invoice PDFs now — they expect to have them by Friday (9/10). I attached a quick usage snapshot we exported for your review.

Can we schedule a 20-minute alignment call next Tuesday (9/13) to walk through the invoice set and confirm renewal terms? Proposed times: 9/13 10:00am PT or 2:00pm PT.

Quoted from Karthik below: 
> I have the primary procurement contact (Amy Liu...)

Attachments: usage-graph-sep2027.png

Jessica Park
Customer Success Manager | LumenTech
jessica@lumentech.com | +1 (206) 555-4456

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jessica Park <jessica@lumentech.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commit validation: LumenTech renewal — evidence queue & churn signals

Thanks Jessica — good to hear finance is on it. Quick FinOps note: when you share invoices please include the invoice number and the GL code if available. That speeds up ARR reconciliation.

I've taken the attached MRR sheet and added a reconciliation tab (see Drive link) with the fields we need: invoice_number, invoice_date, amount_usd, payment_date, GL_code, notes. Once we have those populated I can publish a short reconciliation statement that finance can sign off on.

For the call on 9/13, 2:00pm PT works best for me. Aditya / Karthik — do we want a short agenda? I suggest: 1) confirm invoice set, 2) confirm renewal term and any usage offset, 3) decide stage action (Commit vs At Risk).

I'll also flag this in HubSpot as evidence-pending and add a churn-reason tag: "usage-dip-onprem-pilot" so RevOps sees it.

Naomi Feldman | Senior Finance Manager, Customer Revenue | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199
